greeting.text: Oh! H-hello. I am {npc}. Sorry, I am not very good at meeting people. Are you an adventurer too, {player}?
Hi, I am {npc}! I only started a little while ago, so I do not know much, but I know where the stairs are.
{player}! You are alive. Good. I mean, of course you are, you are strong. I mean... hello.
I was just about to go down. Do you want to come with me? Everything is better with two.
My goddess says I should rest between floors. I get restless, though.

hint.text: Eina says every monster has a Level, and so do we. When I beat something above mine I can feel it, like I took a step I did not know was there.
Fear is the worst monster. If I stop running, I can think. Then I can fight.
A knife is not much, but a knife you trust is enough.
If a monster roars and your legs stop working, it is not shameful. It means the roar is stronger than you, for now. Get stronger, or get a wall.
There is a Minotaur on the upper floors. I met one once. It chose me out of everyone. All I learned is this: stand with a wall behind you and let it hit the wall.
You beat the Minotaur? That is... I mean, I am glad. Welf says that past the stone Goliath there is a black one that his hammer could not scratch. He wants to see how it breaks.
Lili says there is something with two heads in the Water City. She says it like it is a bargain. I trust her about everything except prices.
Ais is waiting for someone to try Udaeus. She does not say so, but she is. I would like to be the one, one day.
You beat all of them! I am going to go and train now, I think. A lot.

farewell.text: Thank you for talking to me. I mean it.
